title: God's Offices (FCP 2026)
synopsis: Djamila wants to take the pill; Zoé’s mum gives her condoms but calls her a whore; Nedjma hides her pills because of her mum; Hélène feels she’s too fertile; Clémence is scared; Adeline would have liked to keep the baby, and so would Margot. Maria Angela would like to know who the father is; Ana Marihas chosen freedom. Denise, Anne, Marta, Yasmine and Milena are the counsellors who listen to them as they wonder how their sexual freedom is possible.
